question: Can a preregistered covariance-derived area-mean variance scale repair P4AG direct LOD without fitted coefficients?

model.spatial_kernel: same truncated separable discrete Gaussian as P4AF
model.lod_peak_density_variance: P4AF peak variance times two-dimensional area variance

evaluation.reference: block-mean full-resolution P4AF density and transmittance

branch_rule.pass: Retain one covariance-moment synthetic LOD candidate and open a separately frozen nonstationary/seam/scale audit.
branch_rule.fail: Close this first-order covariance LOD without coefficient, threshold or marginal rescue; retain full-resolution P4AF only.

forbidden: changing the P4AF marginal, correlation or seeds
stock, process, scanner, calibration or product claims
claim_ceiling: No-fit first-order covariance moment approximation for synthetic P4AF area averaging; not exact nonlinear gamma-copula LOD, measured grain, photographic quality, calibration or product evidence.
